tagline: Translate anything with your own DeepL key, with a history you can search back through.
description:
DeepL Translator is a free app: paste text, pick a source and target language (or let DeepL detect the source automatically), and translate. Every translation is kept in a history you can revisit.

It works on the desktop and as a public page for your Apps Hub account. Your DeepL API key is your own — it is never shared with the server owner or with other Apps Hub users, and it is not required to be the same key everywhere. Get a free key at deepl.com and paste it into Settings to start translating.

Other apps, such as RSS Reader and Nostradamus, can offer a translate button that uses this same key of yours, but only if their administrator has turned that integration on.
capabilities: Translate text between any languages DeepL supports, with automatic source detection.
Full translation history, kept per Apps Hub account and searchable by text.
Works standalone — free forever, with your own DeepL API key.
Works identically on the mvmOS desktop and on a public page for any Apps Hub account.
Other apps can offer one-click translation through your same DeepL key, when their administrator enables it.

integrations.name: RSS Reader
integrations.summary: When RSS Reader's administrator enables the DeepL integration (Premium), readers can translate any article using their own DeepL key entered here.
integrations.requires: A DeepL API key entered in DeepL Translator's own settings.

integrations.name: Nostradamus
integrations.summary: When Nostradamus's administrator enables the DeepL integration (Premium), a translate button appears under posts and in the composer, using the reader's own DeepL key entered here.
integrations.requires: A DeepL API key entered in DeepL Translator's own settings.
